output.brief: The volunteer drop is not mainly the app itself, the background-check renewal, or the competing group. It comes from two changes acting together. Since 1 May, no staff member books regulars into their usual slots at Dock Street and Westgate, because those coordinator posts were cut. The basic-tier app has no recurring bookings, so shifts are released to everyone each Thursday. Regulars there lost their usual slot to new sign-ups. 88% of those who lost it at least twice are now inactive, against 11% of those who kept it. Millbrook has the app but kept its coordinator, and is stable (118 to 111). Quarry Lane lost its coordinator but has no app, because its lead volunteer keeps a paper roster, and it is nearly flat (86 to 80). Only 2 of the 123 who lapsed had an expired background check, and only 2 said they had joined another group. Cancelling RotaWeave would cost $14,000 and would not address the cause. Instead, assign someone to book regulars into their usual slots at Dock Street and Westgate, using the unused admin seat. Phone lapsed regulars to offer their slot back, and review after 60 days. I'm fairly confident, though the causal chain rests on records and callbacks, not a controlled test.
